learning_goals: Read eight short sentences about a home.
Learn seven focus words for objects, locations, and reading.
Use อยู่, มี, and simple descriptions.
Answer four questions and write three short sentences.

sentences.th: ผมอยู่ที่บ้าน
บ้านของผมเล็ก
ในบ้านมีโต๊ะและเก้าอี้
sentences.en: There are a table and a chair in the house.
sentences.zh-TW: 家裡有一張桌子和一張椅子。

sentences.th: หนังสืออยู่บนโต๊ะ
sentences.en: The book is on the table.

sentences.th: เก้าอี้อยู่ใกล้โต๊ะ
sentences.en: The chair is near the table.

sentences.th: ผมอ่านหนังสือที่บ้าน
sentences.en: I read a book at home.

sentences.th: วันนี้ผมดื่มน้ำและอ่านหนังสือ
sentences.en: Today I drink water and read a book.

sentences.th: ผมชอบบ้านของผม

language_notes.en: This is a fictional example. Personalize the home details during practice.
language_notes.zh-TW: 這是虛構的例子。練習時可依自己的家改寫。

language_notes.en: Thai nouns do not require articles such as a or the. The translations use natural English articles.
language_notes.zh-TW: 泰語名詞不需要像英文 a 或 the 這樣的冠詞。英文翻譯依語境使用自然的冠詞。

vocabulary.en: at (before a place in this lesson)

vocabulary_notes.en: Seven focus words: อยู่, ใน, โต๊ะ, เก้าอี้, หนังสือ, บน, อ่าน. ใกล้ and เล็ก were previously encountered in the textbook bank. Other recycled words come from earlier stories or their vocabulary lists; this does not mean they are mastered.
vocabulary_notes.zh-TW: 七個重點詞：อยู่、ใน、โต๊ะ、เก้าอี้、หนังสือ、บน、อ่าน。ใกล้ 和 เล็ก 曾在課本詞彙庫接觸。其他複習詞來自前面的故事或詞彙表，不代表已熟練。

pronunciation.reading_advice_en: Recognize meaningful groups first: ในบ้าน, บนโต๊ะ, ใกล้โต๊ะ, อ่านหนังสือ. School-style transcriptions have not been added to this lesson yet.

notes.note_en: Recognize this group as inside the house.
Recognize this group as on the table.
Recognize this group as near the table.

notes.th: อ่านหนังสือ
notes.note_en: Recognize this group as read a book.
Notice the two syllables: เก้า-อี้. The hyphen is a reading aid only.
Notice the two syllables: หนัง-สือ. Normal spelling has no hyphen.

sentence_patterns.explanation_en: Use อยู่ with a location to say where something is.

examples.th: หนังสืออยู่บนโต๊ะ
examples.en: The book is on the table.

sentence_patterns.pattern_th: ใน + place + มี + thing
sentence_patterns.explanation_en: Start with ใน plus a place, then use มี to say what is there.

examples.th: ในบ้านมีเก้าอี้
examples.en: There is a chair in the house.

sentence_patterns.explanation_en: Put an adjective after the thing being described. A separate word meaning is is not needed here.

examples.th: บ้านของผมเล็ก

comprehension.question_th: บ้านของผมเป็นอย่างไร
comprehension.hint_en: เป็นอย่างไร asks what something is like.
comprehension.explanation_en: บ้านของผมเล็ก means my home is small.

comprehension.question_th: หนังสืออยู่ที่ไหน
comprehension.hint_en: ที่ไหน means where.
comprehension.explanation_en: หนังสืออยู่บนโต๊ะ means the book is on the table.

comprehension.question_th: ผมอ่านอะไร
comprehension.explanation_en: ผมอ่านหนังสือที่บ้าน says I read a book at home.

comprehension.question_th: เก้าอี้อยู่ใกล้อะไร
comprehension.hint_en: ใกล้อะไร means near what.
comprehension.explanation_en: เก้าอี้อยู่ใกล้โต๊ะ means the chair is near the table.

writing.instructions_en: Translate the prompts into Thai before checking the suggested answers. Other appropriate answers may also be valid.

prompts.suggested_answer_th: บ้านของผมเล็ก

prompts.en: The book is on the table.

ผมชอบอ่านหนังสือ

writing.personalization_en: Write two true sentences about objects and locations in your own home.
writing.pronoun_note_en: The narrator uses ผม. Use ฉัน or another suitable self-reference when appropriate.

tasks.instruction_en: Read the eight Thai sentences aloud slowly.
Read again in meaningful groups rather than pausing after every word.
Look around your home and say three sentences about what you see.

speaking.optional_task_en: Record a short voice memo describing your home.

study_schedule.task_en: Read the eight sentences, then check the translations.
study_schedule.task_zh-TW: 先讀八個句子，再查看翻譯。

study_schedule.task_en: Review the seven focus words and reading groups.
study_schedule.task_zh-TW: 複習七個重點詞和詞組。

study_schedule.task_en: Answer the four comprehension questions and write three sentences.
study_schedule.task_zh-TW: 回答四道閱讀理解題，寫三個句子。

study_schedule.task_en: Read aloud and describe your own home.
